q25065.en: Appliances and devices that run on electricity (radio, lights, heated rear window, etc.) increase the vehicle's fuel consumption.

explain.short: Electricity in a car comes from the alternator, which is turned by the engine. More electric devices on means the engine works harder and burns more fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'fanno aumentare' (increase) is correct: even radio and lights cost a little fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Electric devices on = a little more fuel

q25066.en: By keeping the speed as constant as possible, you reduce fuel consumption.

explain.short: Every time you speed up, the engine burns extra fuel. A steady speed avoids these extra bursts, so you use less fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'il più possibile costante' (as constant as possible) is the key: steady speed saves fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Steady speed saves fuel
lines: Avoid speeding up and slowing down

q25067.en: Fuel consumption increases as the weight of the vehicle increases.

explain.short: A heavier vehicle needs more power to move and to speed up. More power means more fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'con l'aumentare del peso' (as the weight increases): more weight, more fuel.

sceneParams.caption: More weight = more fuel

q25068.en: By reducing speed appropriately, fuel consumption goes down.

explain.short: At high speed air resistance grows fast and the engine burns much more fuel. Going a bit slower saves fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'opportunamente' (appropriately) means a sensible speed, not crawling: slower, within reason, saves fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Lower speed = less fuel

q25069.en: To use less fuel, it is advisable to keep the windows closed, especially when travelling at high speed.

explain.short: Open windows break the smooth shape of the car and slow it down with air. At high speed this costs a lot of fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'specie quando si viaggia ad alta velocità' (especially at high speed): the effect is biggest when you go fast.

sceneParams.caption: Windows closed at high speed: less fuel

q25070.en: To use less fuel, it is better to choose, where possible, flat and more free-flowing roads.

explain.short: Hills make the engine work hard, and traffic means stopping and starting. Flat roads with smooth traffic save fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'pianeggianti e più scorrevoli' (flat and free-flowing): no climbs, no stop-and-go.

sceneParams.caption: Flat, free-flowing roads save fuel

q25071.en: Insufficient tyre inflation pressure leads to higher fuel consumption.

explain.short: A soft tyre squashes more on the road and rolls with more effort. The engine must push harder, so it burns more fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'insufficiente' (too low) pressure = 'maggior consumo' (more fuel): soft tyres waste fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Low tyre pressure = more fuel

q25072.en: Putting luggage on the roof of the vehicle leads to higher fuel consumption.

explain.short: Luggage on the roof catches the wind like a wall. Air resistance goes up, and so does fuel use.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'maggior consumo' (more fuel) is right: roof luggage costs fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Roof luggage = more fuel

q25073.en: Keeping the vehicle's sliding sunroof open leads to lower fuel consumption.

explain.short: An open sunroof lets air in and breaks the smooth shape of the car. This increases air resistance, so you use MORE fuel, not less.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'minor consumo' (lower consumption) is the error: an open sunroof means more fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Open sunroof = MORE fuel, not less

q25074.en: Using the air conditioning leads to lower fuel consumption.

explain.short: The air conditioning compressor is driven by the engine. When it is on, the engine works harder and uses more fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'minor consumo' (lower consumption) is the error: air conditioning increases fuel use.

sceneParams.caption: Air conditioning = MORE fuel, not less

q25075.en: Hybrid vehicles (with two engines, a petrol engine and an electric one) pollute more because they are driven by two engines.

explain.short: In a hybrid the electric motor helps or replaces the petrol engine, especially in town. So the petrol engine burns less fuel and the car pollutes LESS.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'inquinano di più' (pollute more) is the error: two motors do not mean more pollution; the electric one emits no exhaust gas.

sceneParams.caption: Hybrid cars pollute LESS, not more

q25076.en: To use less fuel, it is advisable to put the luggage on the roof of the vehicle.

explain.short: Luggage on the roof increases air resistance, so you use MORE fuel. To save fuel, put luggage inside, in the boot.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'per consumare meno' (to use less) is the error: the roof is the worst place for saving fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Roof luggage wastes fuel: use the boot

q25077.en: To use less fuel, it is better to accelerate and brake hard.

explain.short: Hard acceleration burns a lot of fuel, and hard braking throws away the speed you paid for. Smooth driving saves fuel.
explain.rule: You use more fuel with high speed, hard acceleration and braking, extra weight, luggage on the roof, open windows or sunroof, low tyre pressure, air conditioning and other electric devices. Steady, smooth driving on flat, free-flowing roads saves fuel.
explain.trap: 'energicamente' (hard, forcefully) is the error: smooth, gentle driving saves fuel.

sceneParams.caption: Hard acceleration and braking waste fuel

q25078.en: To avoid annoying noise while driving, you must have the silencer (exhaust) checked to make sure it works well.

explain.short: The silencer (marmitta, the exhaust box) reduces engine noise. If it is damaged, the car becomes loud, so it must be checked.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'buone condizioni di efficienza' (in good working order): a working silencer keeps the noise down.

sceneParams.caption: A working silencer keeps the car quiet

q25079.en: Noise pollution increases if the sound warning devices (horn, klaxons) are used too much.

explain.short: Every use of the horn adds noise for everyone around. Using it too often makes noise pollution worse.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'in modo eccessivo' (too much) is the key: the horn is only for real need.

sceneParams.caption: Too much horn = more noise pollution

q25080.en: To avoid annoying noise while driving, you must not brake suddenly, unless it is strictly necessary.

explain.short: Sudden braking makes the tyres and brakes screech. Smooth driving avoids this noise; you brake hard only in a real emergency.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'se non è strettamente necessario' (unless strictly necessary): in an emergency you still brake hard.

sceneParams.caption: No sudden braking unless really needed

q25081.en: To avoid annoying noise, you must not accelerate needlessly and repeatedly when the vehicle is stopped.

explain.short: Revving the engine while standing still only makes noise and smoke. It does not help the car at all.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'inutilmente e ripetutamente' (needlessly and repeatedly): revving when stopped is pure noise.

sceneParams.caption: Don't rev the engine when stopped

q25082.en: To avoid annoying noise while driving, you must use the horn only for road safety reasons (carrying injured or sick people, immediate danger).

explain.short: The horn is a warning tool, not a way to talk or protest. Use it only when safety needs it, for example an immediate danger.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'solamente per motivi di sicurezza' (only for safety reasons) is correct: no horn for greetings or anger.

sceneParams.caption: Horn only for safety reasons

q25083.en: To avoid annoying noise during stops caused by traffic, you must keep the engine running, accelerating repeatedly.

explain.short: Revving the engine while waiting in traffic makes a lot of noise and pollution. In a long stop it is better to switch the engine off.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'accelerando ripetutamente' (accelerating repeatedly) is the error: it causes noise, it does not avoid it.

sceneParams.caption: Revving in traffic makes noise: don't

q25084.en: To avoid annoying noise, you must close the car doors with force, so that you don't have to close them again.

explain.short: Slamming doors makes a loud bang, especially at night. Close them firmly but gently.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'con forza' (with force) is the error: slamming doors is noise, not a way to avoid it.

sceneParams.caption: Slamming doors is noise: close them gently

q25085.en: To avoid annoying noise while driving, you must replace the horn with the flashing lights, but only at night.

explain.short: The horn is used only when safety needs it, day or night. Flashing lights are not a general replacement for it, and the rule is not 'only at night'.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'ma solamente di notte' (but only at night) is the trap: the limit on the horn is about safety, not the time of day.

sceneParams.caption: Horn only for safety, day and night
lines: Horn only when safety needs it

q25085.reviewNote: CdS art. 156: at night the horn should be replaced by headlight flashes; official FALSE rests on 'luci ad intermittenza' and 'solamente'.

q25086.en: The noise produced by motor vehicles increases as the silencer (exhaust) gets damaged.

explain.short: The silencer (marmitta) muffles the engine noise. When it rusts or breaks, more noise comes out.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'man mano che' (gradually, as): the more damaged the silencer, the louder the car.

sceneParams.caption: Damaged silencer = louder car

q25087.en: The noise produced by motor vehicles can be reduced by correct driving that avoids sudden braking or strong acceleration.

explain.short: Strong acceleration makes the engine roar and sudden braking makes tyres screech. Smooth driving is quieter.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'guida corretta' (correct driving) is the key: a calm style lowers noise.

sceneParams.caption: Smooth driving = less noise

q25088.en: The noise produced by motor vehicles is caused only by the engine.

explain.short: Noise comes from many parts: engine, exhaust, tyres on the road, brakes, horn, loose loads and trailers. Not only from the engine.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the error: the engine is one source among many.

sceneParams.caption: Noise comes from many parts, not only the engine

q25089.en: To reduce the noise of motor vehicles, the silencer (exhaust) must be efficient and of an approved type.

explain.short: An approved silencer is tested for that vehicle and keeps noise within the limits. It must also be in good condition.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'efficiente e di tipo approvato' (efficient and approved): both conditions are needed.

sceneParams.caption: Silencer: working and approved

q25090.en: To reduce noise, you must have a damaged silencer replaced with one approved for that type of vehicle.

explain.short: A damaged silencer must be changed. The new one must be approved for your type of vehicle, so it muffles noise as it should.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'approvata per quel tipo di veicolo' (approved for that vehicle type): not any exhaust will do.

sceneParams.caption: Replace a damaged silencer with an approved one

q25091.en: To reduce noise, you must not accelerate when the vehicle is stopped.

explain.short: Pressing the accelerator while standing still only makes noise. It has no useful purpose.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'quando il veicolo è fermo' (when stopped): revving then is just noise.

sceneParams.caption: Don't rev the engine when stopped

q25092.en: To reduce the noise produced by motor vehicles, you must have the brakes checked if they make noise when braking, and replace them if necessary.

explain.short: Squeaking brakes are noisy and often worn. A check, and new parts if needed, removes the noise and keeps you safe.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'sostituendoli se necessario' (replacing them if necessary): checked first, replaced only if needed.

sceneParams.caption: Noisy brakes: check and replace if needed

q25093.en: Checking brakes that make noise, besides increasing safety, can reduce the noise of the vehicle.

explain.short: Noisy brakes are often worn. Fixing them makes braking safer and also makes the car quieter.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'oltre ad aumentare la sicurezza' (besides increasing safety): two benefits, both true.

sceneParams.caption: Fixing noisy brakes: safer and quieter

q25094.en: To reduce the noise of motor vehicles, you must sound the horn as little as possible.

explain.short: Every use of the horn is loud for everyone around. Using it only when really needed keeps noise down.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'il meno possibile' (as little as possible) is correct: the horn is for real need only.

sceneParams.caption: Use the horn as little as possible

q25095.en: To reduce the noise of motor vehicles, it is advisable to make holes in the silencer (exhaust).

explain.short: Holes in the silencer let the noise out: the car becomes much louder. It is also an illegal change.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'praticare dei fori' (make holes) is the error: holes increase noise.

sceneParams.caption: Holes in the silencer make MORE noise

q25096.en: To reduce the noise of motor vehicles, you must replace the exhaust pipe with one of a smaller diameter.

explain.short: The exhaust must stay as approved for the vehicle. A smaller pipe does not make the car quieter; noise is reduced by an efficient, approved silencer.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'diametro più piccolo' (smaller diameter) is the error: changing the pipe size is not the rule.

sceneParams.caption: Keep the approved exhaust, don't change the pipe

q25097.en: To reduce the noise of motor vehicles, it is enough to remove the final part of the silencer (exhaust).

explain.short: Removing part of the silencer takes away its muffling: the car gets much louder. It is also an illegal change.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'basta eliminare' (it is enough to remove) is the error: removing parts increases noise.

sceneParams.caption: Removing part of the silencer = MORE noise

q25098.en: In bends taken at high speed, the tyres skidding (squealing) increases the noise of the vehicle.

explain.short: Too fast in a bend, the tyres slide on the road and squeal. This is noisy and also a sign of danger.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'a forte velocità' (at high speed): fast cornering makes tyres squeal.

sceneParams.caption: Fast bends: tyres squeal, more noise

q25099.en: Empty trailers that bounce too much can be a cause of noise.

explain.short: An empty trailer is light and jumps on bumps, banging and rattling. This makes noise.
explain.rule: Noise (inquinamento acustico, noise pollution) comes from the engine, the exhaust, the tyres, the brakes, the horn and loose loads. To reduce it: an efficient, approved silencer (marmitta), smooth driving, no revving when stopped, quiet brakes, horn only when needed.
explain.trap: 'possono' (can) is correct: bouncing empty trailers may cause noise.

sceneParams.caption: Bouncing empty trailers make noise

q25100.en: To reduce pollution caused by vehicles, you must not accelerate suddenly when starting off.

explain.short: A sudden start burns a lot of fuel at once and sends out more exhaust gas. Gentle starts pollute less.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'bruscamente' (suddenly) is the key: gentle starts, less pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Gentle starts pollute less

q25101.en: To reduce pollution, you must avoid keeping a low gear engaged for too long, if it is not needed.

explain.short: In a low gear the engine turns very fast and burns more fuel. Change up when you can to pollute less.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'se non è necessaria' (if not needed): a low gear is fine on steep hills, not for normal driving.

sceneParams.caption: Change up: low gears too long pollute more

q25102.en: To reduce air pollution caused by petrol-engine vehicles, you must replace the catalytic converter when it is damaged or worn out.

explain.short: The catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica) cleans the exhaust gases. When it is damaged or used up, it stops cleaning, so it must be replaced.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'deteriorata o esausta' (damaged or worn out): a used-up catalyst no longer works.

sceneParams.caption: Worn catalytic converter: replace it
lines: Damaged or worn out: no effect

q25103.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must often check the clutch and the differential.

explain.short: The clutch and the differential pass power to the wheels; they do not affect the exhaust gases. Pollution depends on the engine, its filters and the catalytic converter.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'frizione e differenziale' (clutch and differential) are the wrong parts: they have nothing to do with exhaust gases.

sceneParams.caption: Clutch and differential don't affect pollution
lines: Clutch, differential: no effect on gas

q25104.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must often check the suspension parts (shock absorbers).

explain.short: Shock absorbers matter for safety and comfort, but they do not change the exhaust gases. They do not reduce air pollution.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'ammortizzatori' (shock absorbers) are about safety, not about pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Shock absorbers: safety, not pollution

q25105.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must reduce the tyre inflation pressure.

explain.short: Soft tyres roll with more effort, so the engine burns more fuel and pollutes MORE. Keep the correct pressure.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'ridurre la pressione' (reduce the pressure) is the error: low pressure means more fuel and more pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Low tyre pressure = more fuel, more pollution

q25106.en: To reduce air pollution caused by vehicles, you must accelerate repeatedly while stopped, to keep the engine warm and improve its efficiency.

explain.short: Revving while stopped burns fuel for nothing and sends out more gas. The engine warms up best by driving gently.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'accelerare ripetutamente da fermo' (revving repeatedly while stopped) is the error: it wastes fuel and pollutes.

sceneParams.caption: Revving when stopped wastes fuel and pollutes

q25107.en: In vehicles with a catalytic converter, air pollution is lower just after starting the engine, when the temperature is still low.

explain.short: A catalytic converter works well only when it is hot. Just after a cold start it cleans little, so pollution is HIGHER, not lower.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'minore subito dopo l'accensione' (lower just after starting) is the error: a cold catalyst does not work well.

sceneParams.caption: Cold catalytic converter: MORE pollution

q25108.en: Air pollution produced by vehicles can depend on the engine running irregularly.

explain.short: An engine that runs badly does not burn fuel completely. It sends out more harmful gas.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'può dipendere' (can depend) is correct: a faulty engine pollutes more.

sceneParams.caption: Engine running badly = more pollution

q25109.en: Air pollution can be reduced by checking that the vehicle is always in the best conditions of consumption and efficiency.

explain.short: A well-serviced vehicle burns fuel efficiently and uses less of it. Less fuel burnt means less exhaust gas.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'condizioni ottimali' (best conditions): regular servicing reduces pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Well-kept vehicle = less pollution

q25110.en: By adopting a driving style that limits fuel consumption, it is possible to reduce air pollution.

explain.short: Less fuel burnt means less exhaust gas. Smooth, steady driving saves fuel and the air at the same time.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: Saving fuel and polluting less go together: 'limiti i consumi' = 'ridurre l'inquinamento'.

sceneParams.caption: Less fuel used = less pollution

q25111.en: Air pollution produced by vehicles can be reduced by checking that the air filter is not dirty or clogged.

explain.short: A dirty air filter lets too little air into the engine. The fuel burns badly and the engine pollutes more.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'sporco o intasato' (dirty or clogged): a clean filter helps the engine burn fuel well.

sceneParams.caption: Clean air filter = less pollution

q25112.en: Air pollution produced by vehicles disappears completely if you accelerate fully, because the high temperature makes the fuel burn quickly.

explain.short: Flooring the accelerator burns MORE fuel and sends out more gas. Pollution never disappears completely.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'scompare del tutto' (disappears completely) and 'accelerando a fondo' (full throttle) are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Full throttle = MORE pollution, never zero

q25113.en: Air pollution produced by vehicles decreases if you leave the air conditioning on.

explain.short: The air conditioning takes power from the engine, so it burns more fuel. More fuel means more pollution, not less.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'diminuisce' (decreases) is the error: air conditioning increases fuel use and pollution.

sceneParams.caption: Air conditioning on = MORE pollution

q25114.en: Air pollution is zero in vehicles that meet the "Euro 0" anti-pollution standard.

explain.short: "Euro 0" means the oldest vehicles, made before the Euro emission rules. They pollute the most, far from zero.
explain.rule: Exhaust gases pollute the air. You pollute less with smooth driving (no hard starts, no low gear for too long, no revving when stopped) and a well-kept vehicle: engine working well, clean air filter, a working catalytic converter (marmitta catalitica). No car pollutes zero.
explain.trap: 'nullo' (zero) and 'Euro 0' are the trap: the 0 is not zero pollution, it means no Euro standard at all.

sceneParams.caption: Euro 0 = oldest cars, the MOST pollution
